description: Fetch accessibility issues (paged by cursor) from one source: scanId+scanRunId, buildId, workflowReportId or reportUrl. Ids: startAccessibilityScan or a dashboard link; nothing here lists reports.

buildId.description: Automated Tests: the thBuildId in the build's accessibility report link (not the Automate build id).

reportUrl.description: A Website Scanner or Automated Tests report link from the Accessibility dashboard (carries thBuildId).

scanId.description: Website Scanner: the scan id from startAccessibilityScan.

scanRunId.description: Website Scanner: the scan run id from startAccessibilityScan.

workflowReportId.description: Workflow Analyzer: the report's numeric id.

name: fetchAccessibilityIssues
